name: outputty
description: Claude Code plugin that carries an idea to a merged PR through GitHub Issues: /plan grills, spikes every level, takes your pick and files one ticket; /tickets picks the next; /build takes it to one stacked PR per layer under a /goal you type, docs last. Needs gh and gh stack.

plugins.name: outputty
plugins.description: Six skills (plan, tickets, build, retro, github, init) and the templates a repo needs: a managed CLAUDE.md block, .claude/rules, four product docs (architecture.md as the principles and the end-to-end pipeline), a ticket template, a PR template, a domain-skill template, and settings with the Fable advisor. Tickets are GitHub Issues managed with gh; a build runs under /goal; review is /code-review.
